trigger_items.locator: Targeting, range and line of effect; spell-trigger class-list eligibility; item and wielder caster levels, save DCs and charges.

spell_defenses.locator: Saving Throw; Spell Resistance; spell entries Fireball, Burning Hands, Cone of Cold; Special Abilities / Spell Resistance: one check per casting per creature.
